description: Defines the 'Parser' class for parsing DER-encoded ASN.1 structures, including methods for reading tags, values, sequences, and specific ASN.1 types. It facilitates nested parsing of DER data with restrictions on tag numbers and value length.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class for parsing DER-encoded ASN.1 structures, supporting reading tags, values, sequences, and primitive types, with methods for nested parsing and handling DER restrictions.

methods.name: HasMore
methods.description: Checks if there is more data to parse.

methods.name: ReadTagAndValue
methods.description: Reads current TLV, advances, outputs tag and value.

methods.name: ReadRawTLV
methods.description: Reads current TLV as raw bytes without advancing.

methods.name: ReadOptionalTag
methods.description: Reads optional tag, outputs value if present.

methods.name: ReadTag
methods.description: Reads specific tag, outputs value if matches.

methods.name: ReadConstructed
methods.description: Reads constructed type with specific tag.

methods.name: PeekTagAndValue
methods.description: Peeks at current tag and value without advancing.
